scientific_scope_status: For odd prime p and W<=F_p^N, legal directions D(W,x)=(W intersect product_i{0,+x_i,-x_i}) minus {0}, x in (F_p^*)^N, generate support cone C(W,x). Hypothesis CB requires ONE fixed r in R_{>0}^N belonging to every C(W,x): sum_w lambda_{x,w} 1_{w_i!=0}=r_i with lambda>=0. Unequal coordinate clocks are allowed; state dependence is not. Under CB the note proves log|F_p^N/W|<=N(log3+(4/3)log2), hence p^{codim W}<=K0^N<8^N, K0=3*2^{4/3}. This is conditional existence, not an unconditional cover theorem or efficient algorithm.
